shared_elements: carved relief/sculpted decoration on a vertical, upright field
justification: A depicts a three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure dominated by a large schematic head with brow ridges, nose and mouth atop a blocky body, while B depicts a flat panel with a vertical row of stylised plant forms — palmettes, rosettes and volute-like tendrils on stems — plus faint figural traces at the top. The only correspondence is that both are worked on a tall vertical field in a schematic manner; there is no shared motif, no shared relationship between elements, and the subject matter (a human figure versus a repeating vegetal band) is entirely different.
